sounds._about: A step along the shelf and a light tap on the box there.
The end of the shelf: a dull wooden bump.
An empty place: two soft knocks on the bare shelf.
Only straw: a dry rustle with nothing under it.
Wrapping paper folded round the box while Space is held.
The stamp comes down, and a small bell for a gift done.
The wrong box: paper pulled off, and a low sigh.
Late post: a sack set down on the desk.
